en.title: [Undergraduate] Notice on AI Study Encouragement Student Loan for Fall Semester 2026
summary: Notice on Korea Student Aid Foundation (KOSAF) AI Study Encouragement Student Loan (living expenses) for the Fall Semester of 2026

Eligibility: Undergraduate students in Computer Science and Engineering (컴퓨터공학과) and Artificial Intelligence Engineering (인공지능공학과), completed at least 12 credits in the previous semester, aged 35 or under (no income limit, grade percentile regardless)
Loan terms: Up to 2 million KRW per year (individual total limit 10 million KRW), floating interest rate of 1.7% per annum
Execution period: July 1, 2026 (Wed) 09:00 – November 18, 2026 (Wed) 17:00 (Cannot be executed on weekends and public holidays)
en.easyExplanation: Undergraduate students in Computer Science and Engineering and Artificial Intelligence Engineering (aged 35 or under, with at least 12 credits completed in the previous semester) can apply for the AI Study Encouragement Student Loan of up to 2 million KRW per year. There are no income or GPA percentile restrictions, and you can apply through the Korea Student Aid Foundation (한국장학재단) by November 17, 2026 (Tue) 18:00.
en.target: Undergraduate students in target departments of the AI/SW-Centered University and AI Hub University projects (Computer Science and Engineering (컴퓨터공학과), Artificial Intelligence Engineering (인공지능공학과)), aged 35 or under, with at least 12 completed credits in the previous semester (no income limit, grade percentile regardless)

author: 김소현
originalContent:
안녕하세요.
컴퓨터공학과 학과사무실입니다.
한국장학재단에서 2026-2학기부터 AI학업장려 학자금대출을 운영하고 있어 다음과 같이 안내드립니다.
□ AI학업장려 학자금대출 개요
○ (대출제도) 취업 후 상환 학자금대출(생활비)
○ (대출대상) AI·SW중심대학 및 AI거점대학 사업 대상학과 소속 학부생(컴퓨터공학과, 인공지능공학과 대상)
○ (성적기준) 직전 학기 이수학점 12학점 이상(백분위 성적 무관)
○ (대출연령) 만 35세 이하
○ (소득기준) 제한 없음
○ (대출금리) 연 1.7%(변동금리)
○ (대출한도) 연간 200만 원 이내(개인 총 한도 1,000만 원 이내)
<2026학년도 2학기 AI학업장려 학자금대출 신청·실행 기간>
- (신청기간) 2026. 7. 1.(수) 9시 ~ 11. 17.(화) 18시 ※ 9시 ~ 24시 신청가능(단, 신청마감일은 18시까지)
- (실행기간) 2026. 7. 1.(수) 9시 ~ 11. 18.(수) 17시 ※ 9시 ~ 17시 실행가능(주말 및 공휴일 실행 불가)
